delete.body: {{name}}'s account, profile photo and all records will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone. The person can send a new registration request with Google later.

quota.title: Google quota · today
quota.reset: Daily quotas reset every day at {{time}} (midnight Pacific) · in {{in}}
quota.source: Google does not expose the remaining quota. These numbers come from the app's own log; compare the limits with Google AI Studio > Rate limit.
quota.app: App's own daily cap (all users, Istanbul day)

limits.title: Model limits
limits.hint: Enter the free-tier values from Google AI Studio > Rate limit. RPM: requests per minute, TPM: tokens per minute, RPD: requests per day.

global.title: App's daily AI cap
global.hint: The most AI requests the whole app may make in one Istanbul day, across all users. It protects the shared free Google quota. 0 switches AI off for everyone.
global.label: Requests per day
global.invalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to {{max}}.

reports.title: Error reports
reports.noRequest: No failed request was captured. Recent requests:

mode.title: Who can join
mode.openHint: Everyone can sign in and send a registration request.
mode.inviteHint: Only e-mail addresses on the invite list below can sign in.

approval.title: Approve new accounts by hand
approval.on: New accounts wait in Registration requests until you approve them.
approval.off: New accounts can use the app right after onboarding.

invite.title: Invite list
invite.enforced: Only these addresses can sign in.
invite.notEnforced: Not enforced while anyone can join. It takes effect when you switch to invite only.
invite.invalid: That does not look like an e-mail address.

users.title: Users
users.aiLimitHint: Food estimates and coach messages per day. Default {{n}}, 0 turns AI off for this person, at most {{max}}.
users.aiLimitInvalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to {{max}}.
users.selfNote: This is your own account; you cannot block yourself.
users.adminNote: Admins cannot be blocked. Remove the admin role first.
users.blockHint: A blocked person cannot open the app and disappears from the leaderboard. Their data stays.
users.blockConfirm: Block {{name}}? They lose access to the app until you unblock them.
users.blockedNote: This person is blocked and cannot open the app.
